demos.name: Aurora
demos.title: Aurora
demos.summary: Layered curtains of light drift across a dark hero.
demos.watch: Native WebGL2; tune brightness and keep text on a readable layer.

demos.name: Silk
demos.title: Silk
demos.summary: A softly lit fabric surface ripples and responds to the pointer.
demos.use: Atmospheric editorial and premium product backgrounds
demos.watch: Native WebGL2; subtle motion works best behind concise content.

demos.name: Orb
demos.title: Orb
demos.summary: A luminous energy orb bends and pulses with pointer interaction.
demos.use: AI entry points, assistants and focused hero moments
demos.watch: Native WebGL2; provide a static fallback for unsupported devices.

demos.name: BlurText
demos.title: Blur Text
demos.summary: Words resolve from a soft blur into a clear headline.
demos.watch: React + Motion; semantic text remains present, and reduced motion uses a clear reveal.

demos.name: RotatingText
demos.title: Rotating Text
demos.summary: Spring-driven words cycle through a compact headline.
demos.use: Communicate several qualities in one headline
demos.watch: React + Motion; keep essential information readable without waiting for a cycle.

demos.name: TiltedCard
demos.title: Tilted Card
demos.summary: A layered visual card tilts towards the pointer with spring motion.
demos.use: Featured work, products and collectible artwork
demos.watch: React + Motion; upstream interaction is pointer-based. Touch receives a static readable card. Artwork is original.

demos.name: GlassIcons
demos.title: Glass Icons
demos.summary: Translucent icon buttons combine refraction, coloured plates and responsive motion.
demos.use: A small set of expressive navigation or feature shortcuts
demos.watch: React, canvas and optional WebGL; keep visible labels and test contrast. Icons and action feedback are original demo content.

demos.name: PixelTransition
demos.title: Pixel Transition
demos.summary: A mosaic of pixels swaps between two original compositions.
demos.use: Reveals, before-and-after cards and playful interaction
demos.watch: React + canvas; click, tap or press Enter to switch. The artwork is original.
